desc:
It’s time to go back to the island! 

Alliances. Betrayals. Brutal challenges. And alllll the drama. 

Join the official Total Drama Island multiplayer tournament on Roblox from the makers of the hit TV series!

Outplay your competitors on the challenges - then scheme, plot, and do whatever you have to do to survive the vote off. 

Will you get a marshmallow? Or go home on the boat of losers? 

It’s classic Total Drama Island vibes with a fresh Roblox twist. 🏕️ 

🎯 Fast, funny mini-games inspired by the show

🗳️ Vote, strategize, and survive each round

👥 Party with friends or join new rivals in public matches

🔥 Collect coins to unlock iconic characters and items
